---
title: "renv::snapshot() can downgrade the R version in the lockfile"
ref: RNV-03
categories: [renv and installation]
impact: silencieux
attendu: "the R version of the session, 4.5.1"
versions: "Observed with {renv} 1.2.x"
source: "Slack ThinkR (2026)"
---

::: {.piege .piege-statique}
```r
R.version.string
renv::snapshot()
```

```text
[1] "R version 4.5.1 (2025-06-13)"

The version of R recorded in the lockfile will be updated:
- R             [4.5.1 -> 4.4.2]
```
:::

This pitfall depends on the settings of a {renv} project, so it cannot be replayed in the browser.

## Why

{renv} lets you set, in the project settings, the R version to record in the lockfile (`renv::settings$r.version()`). When that setting exists, `snapshot()` writes it instead of the version actually in use. Here the session runs R 4.5.1, but the lockfile goes back to 4.4.2, the value forgotten in the settings.

The message is shown, but in the middle of the list of updated packages, where nobody reads it.

## The fix

Check that setting, and clear it if it is not intended, before taking a snapshot.

::: {.piege .piege-statique}
```r
renv::settings$r.version()
renv::settings$r.version(NULL)
renv::snapshot()
```
:::
